claim: The 128K ROM 1 differs from Sinclair's 48K ROM in keypad code, so ROM-path checks need the right ROM 1 (tried as the 48K ROM and per segment) and recordings made on the other ROM can desync.

evidence.text: Observed 29 MISMATCH reads when the 48K ROM was used for a 128K ROM 1 image; the fade reads every ROM byte.

128-1.rom has keypad code at 0x386E on the ISR path and a stub there broke replay; recordings on the 48K ROM desynced the 128K run at frame 2; the Bridge star map reads ROM 0 at 0x0D00-0x0D20 (33 bytes seen).
